> [!question] Prompt
>
> Write in the present tense as if it is three months in the future.
>
> Where do I want to be and how do I want to feel in three months?

## Personal

- How does my personal life look?
	- Mental Health
		- I am mentally strong and resilient.
		- I am maintaining my habits and routines that ground me.
		- I have learned how to implement techniques to get me out of a rut.
	- Physical Health
		- My daily exercise habit has paid off and I have good core strength.
	- Education
		- I have learned machine learning and currently improving my math and business skills.

## Interpersonal

- How does my interpersonal life look?
	- Marriage
		- My relationship with Sam is continually getting better.
		- We have learned better ways to fight and make up.
	- Family
		- I have a better connection with Bubbie, Phyllis, and Fred.
	- Friends
		- I make time every other week to see friends.

## Professional

- How does my professional life look?
	- Day-to-day
		- I am data analyst
		- I am fulfilled by my job.
	- Career Development
		- I am finding ways to be a better communicator.
